findings.failing_input: sync-now returns 500 (operator's Inngest is down). The hook console.warns but still proceeds into the 90s poll loop, polling /api/data which has nothing new to report — the operator waits the full 90s before seeing the watchdog warn at line 113-115, with no UI signal that the trigger actually failed.
findings.expected: On non-202/non-ok sync-now response, fail fast rather than waste 90s polling.
findings.actual: Polls for 90s then mutates anyway; operator sees spinner spinning needlessly.
findings.fix_sketch: After line 69, if !res.ok && res.status !== 202: set a flag, skip the poll loop, still call mutate() (so SWR re-reads); reduce wait to one-shot.
findings.regression_test_idea: Stub sync-now to return 500; assert refresh completes within < POLL_INTERVAL_MS and mutate is still called.
